overview: Saint Vincent and the Grenadines is an island country in the eastern Caribbean, made up of the main island of Saint Vincent and a chain of smaller islands called the Grenadines. Its capital is Kingstown. It became independent from the United Kingdom in 1979.

geography.text: Saint Vincent is a mountainous, green volcanic island with black sand beaches, and its volcano, La Soufrière, erupted in 2021. The Grenadines to the south are small, low islands surrounded by coral reefs and are popular for sailing.

history.text: The Garifuna, descended from Kalinago people and escaped Africans, fought to keep Saint Vincent until the British defeated them in 1797 and deported most of them to Central America. The island became independent in 1979. Its volcano, La Soufrière, has erupted several times, including in 1902, 1979 and 2021.

events.title: Garifuna deported
events.text: Thousands of Garifuna are shipped to an island off Honduras.

events.title: Independence
events.text: Saint Vincent and the Grenadines becomes independent.

events.title: Another eruption
events.text: La Soufrière erupts again, forcing thousands to leave their homes.

government.text: Saint Vincent and the Grenadines is a constitutional monarchy within the Commonwealth. The British monarch is head of state, represented by a Governor-General. The Prime Minister leads the government. In 2009 voters rejected a proposal to become a republic.

economy.text: Bananas and other farming, tourism, especially to the Grenadine islands, and money from abroad support the economy. The 2021 eruption of La Soufrière volcano caused serious damage.

culture.text: The country is made up of the main island, Saint Vincent, and about 30 small islands and cays. The Garifuna, descendants of the Kalinago and escaped Africans, came from Saint Vincent before most were exiled in 1797. Some of the Pirates of the Caribbean films were shot there.

items.title: The Grenadines
items.text: Small islands such as Bequia and Mustique.

items.title: Pirates of the Caribbean
items.text: Wallilabou Bay was used as a film set.

sport.text: Cricket is the most popular sport, and Saint Vincent plays as part of the West Indies. Sailing and football are also popular.

items.title: Arnos Vale
items.text: The island's cricket ground, which has hosted Test matches.

didYouKnow: Mustique, one of the Grenadines, is a private island popular with celebrities.
La Soufrière volcano erupted in 2021 for the first time since 1979.

keyPeople.name: Joseph Chatoyer
keyPeople.text: Led resistance to British rule; a National Hero.

keyPeople.name: Kevin Lyttle
keyPeople.text: His song 'Turn Me On' was a worldwide hit.
